capabilities: Insert links via a configurable trigger character
Create notes when no note exists at the link location
Apply Templater or QuickAdd templates to newly created notes
Limit note suggestions and plugin activity to specific folders
extras: Template insertion explicitly does not work with templates made for the core Templates plugin, and a restart may be needed after installing Templater, QuickAdd, or this plugin. Linking to blocks (^) is not supported; the Todo list marks several features as unfinished.
problem: Obsidian's built-in [[ link suggestion cannot create the note at the linked location or apply a template when the linked note does not exist.

relations.evidence: Inserting templates only works if either the Templater or QuickAdd plugin is installed and enabled.

summary: Autocomplete-style link suggestion triggered by a custom character that creates missing notes and can apply Templater or QuickAdd templates.
